repos_data.description: ⚡ Professional Golang SDK for Bybit V5 API. Lightning-fast trading with real-time WebSocket streams, complete REST API coverage, and production-ready features. Supports spot & derivatives trading, HMAC/RSA authentication, multi-region endpoints, and advanced order types with TP/SL. Goroutine-safe, testnet-ready, zero dependencies. 🚀

Full-featured Golang SDK for BingX cryptocurrency exchange API. Supports USDT-M & Coin-M perpetual futures, spot trading, market data, WebSocket streams, account management, and copy trading. Type-safe, production-ready with HMAC-SHA256 security. Complete API coverage with idiomatic Go interfaces.

Idiomatic Go SDK for KuCoin REST & WebSocket APIs — UTA (Unified Trading Account) and Classic (Spot, Margin, Futures). Hand-written, not generated. String-typed prices, HMAC-SHA256 auth, context-aware methods, typed error hierarchy, conservative retry policy, injectable HTTP client, and manifest-driven endpoint documentation.

repo_meta_data.description: Lightweight Go SDK for Telegram Wallet Pay. Integrate crypto payments (TON, USDT, BTC, NOT) into Telegram bots effortlessly. Includes secure HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification, middleware for net/http, Gin, and Echo. Zero dependencies for core client, typed error handling, and full test coverage. MIT licensed
